rules.rule: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after return pickup is completed and quality check is passed.
conditions: Return must be picked up successfully
Item must pass quality inspection at warehouse
exceptions: Refunds may be delayed during peak sale events
Bank holidays may extend the timeline

rules.rule: UPI and wallet refunds are credited within 24 hours. Credit/debit card refunds take 5-7 business days. EMI refunds are reversed in next billing cycle.
conditions: Refund credited to original payment method
exceptions: COD orders are refunded to ShopEase wallet or bank account on customer choice

rules.rule: Partial refunds are issued when a multi-item order has only some items returned. Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the entire order is returned.
conditions: Original shipping charges deducted on partial returns
exceptions: Damaged item returns include full shipping refund
